issues.description: Column in SELECT projection for Schwimmbad: the problem statement (task description) requires the Schwimmbad name and type ('Namen und Art aller Schwimmbäder'), but the solution repository's query projects Schwimmbad.id instead of Schwimmbad.name. This mismatch between the requested output column (name) and the solution's selected column (id) will cause students' queries or automated checks expecting the name to disagree with the provided solution and may confuse students about which column is required.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the solution query to select the Schwimmbad name instead of the id. For example: SELECT Schwimmbad.name, Schwimmbad.art AS Art, Gemeinde.name, Gemeinde.einwohner_m, Gemeinde.einwohner_w FROM Schwimmbad, Gemeinde WHERE Gemeinde.schluessel = Schwimmbad.gemeindeschluessel

issues.description: Concept: the "name" of a Schwimmbad (swimming-pool). Problem statement requests Schwimmbad names (it asks for "Namen und Art aller Schwimmbäder"), but the solution query selects Schwimmbad.id (SELECT Schwimmbad.id, Schwimmbad.art ...) instead of Schwimmbad.name. A student reading the task expects to output Schwimmbad.name, while the reference solution returns the numeric id column, which breaks the direct mapping from requirement -> selected column and will confuse or mislead students.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the SELECT in solution_repository/aufgabe03.sql to return Schwimmbad.name instead of Schwimmbad.id. For example: SELECT Schwimmbad.name, Schwimmbad.art as Art, Gemeinde.name, Gemeinde.einwohner_m, Gemeinde.einwohner_w FROM Schwimmbad, Gemeinde WHERE Gemeinde.schluessel = Schwimmbad.gemeindeschluessel
